encounter.text: A rat crouches in an alcove, pressing their ear against the pipe wall. They hold a finger up for silence. After a long moment, they pull away. 'There it is again. Scratching. Regular. Too regular to be rats.' They look at you. 'Someone — or something — is writing on the pipes down here. I've followed it twice. Never found the end of the marks.'

direction.text: 'Always deeper. The marks get denser the further down you go. I turned back at the third junction — there were things moving in the water by then.' They press something into your hand. A coin, worn smooth, with a symbol scratched into it matching the pipe marks. 'Found it near the source. You'll want to know what that means before this is over.'

choices.text: Take the coin and press on.

listen.text: You press your ear to the pipe. Cold metal. Then — faint, rhythmic, like something writing in a language you almost recognise. It stops. Starts again. The rat nods grimly. 'You hear it. Good. Most don't stay long enough.'
